correctness.rationale: The flow-table constraints are solved in both directions; \(0<a,b<h\) and \(\max(0,J)<x<\min(h,h+J)\) enforce every transition positive. Explicit reversal differences give \(\tau=4|J|\). Markov path factorization yields \(D_n=(n-3)D_4\). An exact derivative with sign of \(2x-h-J\) gives the sharp minimizer \(x=(h+J)/2\) and bound \(2\tau\operatorname{artanh}(2\tau)\). Endpoint divergence plus continuity gives the complete region, including the isolated origin; a standalone checker independently tests rational parameter examples and word sums.

value.rationale: The first detectable binary finite-memory arrow-of-time regime remains exactly iid-fair on all windows of length at most three. The full tight nonlinear relation between four-word detectability and asymptotic entropy rate, together with equality rigidity and complete attainability, supplies a substantive experimentally interpretable information-cost benchmark. It is not a routine substitution into a generic KL inequality; the stationary de Bruijn flow constraints determine its stronger coefficient and finite arrow cap.
